prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
Create one 10-second video.
FORMAT: vertical 9:16, 1080 by 1920 pixels, 24 frames per second.
STYLE: flat 2D vector animation with clean geometric shapes and a uniform thin line weight. No photorealism. Use only these colors: solid dark charcoal-navy background (#101626) with no texture or pattern, electric blue (#2F80ED) for lines and accents, white (#FFFFFF) for highlights, and one supporting accent color, light sky blue (#8FB8F5). No people, no faces and no hands. Clean, modern, trustworthy technology mood. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the video. Soft background music is fine, but no voice and no spoken words.
CAMERA: One very slow push-in toward the cart.
SCENE: Four beats in one continuous shot. [00:00 to 00:02.5] The electric-blue outline of a shopping cart draws itself line by line in the center of the empty navy background, with one soft glow behind it. [00:02.5 to 00:05] Four simple outline icons slide in from the four edges and orbit the cart slowly: a wireless earbuds case, a power bank, a smartphone and a smartwatch. [00:05 to 00:07.5] The four icons drop into the cart one after another, each with a small white spark. [00:07.5 to 00:10] A white circle with a checkmark appears above the cart and glows softly, and the cart rolls a short distance to the center with three thin speed lines, then stops.
ENDING: The cart stands centered with the four icons inside it and the checkmark glowing above it, and the camera is completely still for the final second.
AVOID: No text, letters, numbers or logos. No people, faces or hands. No photorealism. No sudden jumps or flickering. Keep every shape simple and clean, and keep the same colors in every beat.

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
FORMAT AND STYLE
A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a deep, seamless dark charcoal-navy (#101626) studio backdrop with a soft electric-blue glow behind the product and no horizon line, no floor line and no visible shadows on the backdrop. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the power bank, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright or at the same angle as in the photo, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.
THE LIGHT ELEMENTS (use only these, nothing else)
Three thin ribbons of glowing electric-blue light and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.
LIGHTING AND COLOR
A large, soft studio light from the upper left, a thin bright electric-blue (#2F80ED) rim light from behind that outlines the product, and soft reflections on its surfaces. The color palette is dark charcoal-navy, electric blue and white. The mood is clean, modern, premium and trustworthy.
SCENE BY SCENE
[00:00 to 00:02.5] SCENE 1, THE REVEAL.
Shot: a wide shot slowly pushing in to a medium shot. Action: the product floats alone in the center of the empty space and turns very slightly left and then right, no more than about 15 degrees, so its front always stays visible. One bright streak of light sweeps across its surface from left to right. Sound: a soft, airy chime on the reveal. Transition: a soft light flash.
[00:02.5 to 00:05] SCENE 2, THE DETAIL.
Shot: a close macro shot of the edges, the ports and the surface finish of the power bank, with the camera sliding slowly from left to right and a very shallow depth of field. Action: the materials and edges catch the light, and a few tiny glowing blue particles drift through the blurred foreground. Sound: a quiet, warm shimmer. Transition: the particles swell into a soft glowing blur that fills the frame, then clears.
[00:05 to 00:07.5] SCENE 3, THE ENERGY.
Shot: a medium shot with the product in the center and the camera nearly still. Action: In slow motion, three thin ribbons of electric-blue light glide in from outside the frame and travel around the power bank in a gentle, wide spiral, like a slow ring around a planet, with tiny glowing particles trailing behind them. The product stays still and sharp in the center, and nothing passes in front of it. Sound: a soft rising shimmer with a gentle whoosh. Transition: the light expands outward.
[00:07.5 to 00:10] SCENE 4, THE HERO HOLD.
Shot: the camera pulls back smoothly to a medium-wide shot. Action: The ribbons slow down and settle into a soft, balanced circle of light around the power bank, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. In the last half second the motion becomes almost still, with one small glint of light across the product. Sound: the music resolves into one warm final note.
AUDIO OVERALL
A smooth, modern, upbeat electronic instrumental with a gentle build, a soft whoosh on each transition and a gentle shimmer when the light elements appear. No vocals and no spoken words.
AVOID
No text, numbers, subtitles, logos or brand names added to the video. No changes to the product's shape, color, buttons, ports or marks. No people, hands, cars or other objects. Nothing covering or touching the product. No cartoon or animated style. No sudden jumps, flickering or morphing of the product. No spoken dialogue.

It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a deep, seamless dark charcoal-navy (#101626) studio backdrop with a soft electric-blue glow behind the product and no horizon line, no floor line and no visible shadows on the backdrop. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the power bank, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright or at the same angle as in the photo, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.

Three thin ribbons of glowing electric-blue light and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.

The product stays still and sharp in the center, and nothing passes in front of it. Sound: a soft rising shimmer with a gentle whoosh. Transition: the light expands outward.
[00:07.5 to 00:10] SCENE 4, THE HERO HOLD.
Shot: the camera pulls back smoothly to a medium-wide shot. Action: The ribbons slow down and settle into a soft, balanced circle of light around the power bank, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
FORMAT AND STYLE
A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a deep, seamless dark charcoal-navy (#101626) studio backdrop with a soft electric-blue glow behind the product and no horizon line, no floor line and no visible shadows on the backdrop. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the wireless earbuds together with their charging case, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright or at the same angle as in the photo, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.
THE LIGHT ELEMENTS (use only these, nothing else)
Thin rings of glowing electric-blue light that look like gentle sound waves, and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.
LIGHTING AND COLOR
A large, soft studio light from the upper left, a thin bright electric-blue (#2F80ED) rim light from behind that outlines the product, and soft reflections on its surfaces. The color palette is dark charcoal-navy, electric blue and white. The mood is clean, modern, premium and trustworthy.
SCENE BY SCENE
[00:00 to 00:02.5] SCENE 1, THE REVEAL.
Shot: a wide shot slowly pushing in to a medium shot. Action: the product floats alone in the center of the empty space and turns very slightly left and then right, no more than about 15 degrees, so its front always stays visible. One bright streak of light sweeps across its surface from left to right. Sound: a soft, airy chime on the reveal. Transition: a soft light flash.
[00:02.5 to 00:05] SCENE 2, THE DETAIL.
Shot: a close macro shot of the case lid, the hinge and the earbuds, with the camera sliding slowly from left to right and a very shallow depth of field. Action: the materials and edges catch the light, and a few tiny glowing blue particles drift through the blurred foreground. Sound: a quiet, warm shimmer. Transition: the particles swell into a soft glowing blur that fills the frame, then clears.
[00:05 to 00:07.5] SCENE 3, THE ENERGY.
Shot: a medium shot with the product in the center and the camera nearly still. Action: In slow motion, five thin rings of electric-blue light expand outward one after another around the earbuds and the case, like gentle ripples of sound, with tiny particles drifting between the rings. The product stays still and sharp in the center, and nothing passes in front of it. Sound: a soft rising shimmer with a gentle whoosh. Transition: the light expands outward.
[00:07.5 to 00:10] SCENE 4, THE HERO HOLD.
Shot: the camera pulls back smoothly to a medium-wide shot. Action: The rings slow down and fade into one soft, calm circle of light around the earbuds and the case, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. In the last half second the motion becomes almost still, with one small glint of light across the product. Sound: the music resolves into one warm final note.
AUDIO OVERALL
A smooth, modern, upbeat electronic instrumental with a gentle build, a soft whoosh on each transition and a gentle shimmer when the light elements appear. No vocals and no spoken words.
AVOID
No text, numbers, subtitles, logos or brand names added to the video. No changes to the product's shape, color, buttons, ports or marks. No people, hands, cars or other objects. Nothing covering or touching the product. No cartoon or animated style. No sudden jumps, flickering or morphing of the product. No spoken dialogue.

A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the smartwatch, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright or at the same angle as in the photo, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.
THE LIGHT ELEMENTS (use only these, nothing else)
One thin ring of glowing electric-blue light and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.
LIGHTING AND COLOR
A large, soft studio light from the upper left, a thin bright electric-blue (#2F80ED) rim light from behind that outlines the product, and soft reflections on its surfaces. The color palette is dark charcoal-navy, electric blue and white. The mood is clean, modern, premium and trustworthy.
SCENE BY SCENE
[00:00 to 00:02.5] SCENE 1, THE REVEAL.
Shot: a wide shot slowly pushing in to a medium shot. Action: the product floats alone in the center of the empty space and turns very slightly left and then right, no more than about 15 degrees, so its front always stays visible. One bright streak of light sweeps across its surface from left to right. Sound: a soft, airy chime on the reveal. Transition: a soft light flash.
[00:02.5 to 00:05] SCENE 2, THE DETAIL.
Shot: a close macro shot of the watch face, the crown or buttons and the strap, with the camera sliding slowly from left to right and a very shallow depth of field. Action: the materials and edges catch the light, and a few tiny glowing blue particles drift through the blurred foreground. Sound: a quiet, warm shimmer. Transition: the particles swell into a soft glowing blur that fills the frame, then clears.
[00:05 to 00:07.5] SCENE 3, THE ENERGY.
Shot: a medium shot with the product in the center and the camera nearly still. Action: In slow motion, one thin ring of electric-blue light orbits the watch slowly like a halo, tilting gently, with tiny glowing particles trailing behind it. The ring never crosses in front of the watch face. The product stays still and sharp in the center, and nothing passes in front of it. Sound: a soft rising shimmer with a gentle whoosh. Transition: the light expands outward.

Shot: the camera pulls back smoothly to a medium-wide shot. Action: The ring slows down and settles into a soft, balanced circle of light around the watch, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. In the last half second the motion becomes almost still, with one small glint of light across the product. Sound: the music resolves into one warm final note.
AUDIO OVERALL
A smooth, modern, upbeat electronic instrumental with a gentle build, a soft whoosh on each transition and a gentle shimmer when the light elements appear. No vocals and no spoken words.
AVOID
No text, numbers, subtitles, logos or brand names added to the video. No changes to the product's shape, color, buttons, ports or marks. No people, hands, cars or other objects. Nothing covering or touching the product. No cartoon or animated style. No sudden jumps, flickering or morphing of the product. No spoken dialogue.

posts.hook: "Chaja yenye watt nyingi haiharibu simu yako." (A higher-watt charger does not damage your phone.)
posts.message: A phone only takes the power it can handle, so a stronger charger does not push too much into it. The charger should still be a good-quality one.
posts.cta: Comment ORAIMO for chargers.
posts.attach: Nothing to attach.
posts.notes:
CapCut Text:
1. The hook above.
2. "Chaja kubwa, simu ndogo" (big charger, small phone).
3. "Simu huchukua kinachohitaji tu" (the phone takes only what it needs).
4. "Chagua chaja bora" (choose a quality charger).

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
Create one 10-second video.
FORMAT: vertical 9:16, 1080 by 1920 pixels, 24 frames per second.
STYLE: flat 2D vector animation with clean geometric shapes and a uniform thin line weight. No photorealism. Use only these colors: solid dark charcoal-navy background (#101626) with no texture or pattern, electric blue (#2F80ED) for lines and accents, white (#FFFFFF) for highlights, and one supporting accent color, soft green (#3DBE8B). No people, no faces and no hands. Clean, modern, trustworthy technology mood. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the video. Soft background music is fine, but no voice and no spoken words.
CAMERA: One very slow push-in toward the small phone.
SCENE: Four beats in one continuous shot. [00:00 to 00:02.5] A large flat vector wall charger stands on the left of the navy background and a small flat vector smartphone with an empty battery bar stands on the right. [00:02.5 to 00:05] A small gate shape drawn in the middle between them opens only a little. [00:05 to 00:07.5] A small, steady stream of electric-blue energy dots flows through the gate to the phone, even though many more dots wait behind the gate on the charger side. [00:07.5 to 00:10] The phone battery bar fills smoothly and a soft green checkmark circle glows above the phone.
ENDING: The phone battery bar is full with the soft green checkmark glowing, the large charger rests calmly on the left, and the camera is completely still for the final second.
AVOID: No text, letters, numbers or logos. No people, faces or hands. No photorealism. No sudden jumps or flickering. Keep every shape simple and clean, and keep the same colors in every beat.

posts.caption:
Chaja yenye watt nyingi haiharibu simu yako.
Simu huchukua nguvu inayoweza kuhimili tu, hata kama chaja ina nguvu zaidi. Muhimu ni kutumia chaja bora yenye ubora unaoaminika.
A phone only takes the power it can handle, even if the charger is stronger. What matters is using a good-quality charger.
Andika ORAIMO kupata orodha ya chaja.

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
FORMAT AND STYLE
A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, each from a different camera angle, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a deep, seamless dark charcoal-navy (#101626) studio backdrop with no horizon line. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the Bluetooth speaker, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product stands still and stable in the center of a flat, glossy, dark reflective surface that shows a soft, realistic reflection, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.
THE LIGHT ELEMENTS (use only these, nothing else)
Thin rings of glowing electric-blue light that pulse outward on the glossy surface like ripples in water, and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.
LIGHTING AND COLOR
A large, soft studio light from the upper left, a thin bright electric-blue (#2F80ED) rim light from behind that outlines the product, and soft reflections on its surfaces. The color palette is dark charcoal-navy, electric blue and white. The mood is clean, modern, premium and trustworthy.
SCENE BY SCENE
[00:00 to 00:02.5] SCENE 1, THE LOW ANGLE HERO.
Shot: the camera sits very low, at the level of the surface, looking up at the product, and slowly arcs from the left to the right by about 20 degrees. Action: the product stands tall and proud, with its reflection glowing on the glossy surface. One bright streak of light sweeps across it. Sound: a soft, bright chime. Transition: a soft light bloom that fades into the next scene.
[00:02.5 to 00:05] SCENE 2, THE PULSE.
Shot: a medium front shot with a still camera. Action: Thin rings of electric-blue light pulse outward from the base of the speaker across the glossy surface, one ring every half second, like ripples in water, with the reflection of the speaker glowing softly below it. Nothing touches the product. Sound: a soft, rhythmic pulse. Transition: a quick, smooth rise of the camera upward.
[00:05 to 00:07.5] SCENE 3, THE CLOSE-UP.
Shot: a close macro shot at a slight angle of the speaker grille, the buttons and the edges, with the camera sliding slowly from right to left and a shallow depth of field. Action: A single ring of electric-blue light passes slowly across the glossy surface in front of the speaker while the grille texture catches the light, and a few tiny particles drift in the blurred foreground. Sound: a soft shimmer. Transition: a soft light flash.
[00:07.5 to 00:10] SCENE 4, THE HERO HOLD.
Shot: the camera rises and tilts to a high angle of about 45 degrees and then pulls back slowly to reveal the whole scene. Action: The rings slow down and fade into one wide, calm circle of light on the surface around the speaker, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. In the last half second the motion becomes almost still, with one small glint of light on the product. Sound: the music resolves into one warm final note.
AUDIO OVERALL
A smooth, modern, upbeat electronic instrumental with a gentle build, a soft whoosh on each transition and a gentle shimmer when the light elements appear. No vocals and no spoken words.
AVOID
No text, numbers, subtitles, logos or brand names added to the video. No changes to the product's shape, color, buttons, ports or marks. No people, hands, cars or other objects. Nothing covering or touching the product. No cartoon or animated style. No sudden jumps, flickering or morphing of the product. No spoken dialogue.

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
FORMAT AND STYLE
A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a deep, seamless dark charcoal-navy (#101626) studio backdrop with a soft electric-blue glow behind the product and no horizon line, no floor line and no visible shadows on the backdrop. There are no people, no hands, no on-screen text, no numbers, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the wall charger, shown in the attached image. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same shape and proportions, the same colors and materials, the same buttons and ports, and the same brand marks and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text, numbers, icons or pictures to its screen or body. The product floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright or at the same angle as in the photo, with its front facing the camera. If the product has a cable, show it exactly as in the photo as one single strand with no branches, forks, knots or extra ends. The product never changes shape, size or color in any scene, and it is always the sharpest and most important object in the frame.
THE LIGHT ELEMENTS (use only these, nothing else)
Thin streaks of glowing electric-blue light that look like energy sparks, and tiny glowing blue particles. The light elements never touch, cover or hide the product.
LIGHTING AND COLOR
A large, soft studio light from the upper left, a thin bright electric-blue (#2F80ED) rim light from behind that outlines the product, and soft reflections on its surfaces. The color palette is dark charcoal-navy, electric blue and white. The mood is clean, modern, premium and trustworthy.
SCENE BY SCENE
[00:00 to 00:02.5] SCENE 1, THE REVEAL.
Shot: a wide shot slowly pushing in to a medium shot. Action: the product floats alone in the center of the empty space and turns very slightly left and then right, no more than about 15 degrees, so its front always stays visible. One bright streak of light sweeps across its surface from left to right. Sound: a soft, airy chime on the reveal. Transition: a soft light flash.
[00:02.5 to 00:05] SCENE 2, THE DETAIL.
Shot: a close macro shot of the plug pins, the USB port and the surface finish of the charger, with the camera sliding slowly from left to right and a very shallow depth of field. Action: the materials and edges catch the light, and a few tiny glowing blue particles drift through the blurred foreground. Sound: a quiet, warm shimmer. Transition: the particles swell into a soft glowing blur that fills the frame, then clears.
[00:05 to 00:07.5] SCENE 3, THE ENERGY.
Shot: a medium shot with the product in the center and the camera nearly still. Action: In slow motion, four thin streaks of electric-blue light glide in from outside the frame and travel around the charger in a gentle, wide spiral, like a slow ring around a planet, with tiny glowing particles trailing behind them. The product stays still and sharp in the center, and nothing passes in front of it. Sound: a soft rising shimmer with a gentle whoosh. Transition: the light expands outward.
[00:07.5 to 00:10] SCENE 4, THE HERO HOLD.
Shot: the camera pulls back smoothly to a medium-wide shot. Action: The streaks slow down and settle into a soft, balanced circle of light around the charger, with a few particles hovering gently. The product sits in the lower middle of the frame, with clean empty space in the upper third for text to be added later. In the last half second the motion becomes almost still, with one small glint of light across the product. Sound: the music resolves into one warm final note.
AUDIO OVERALL
A smooth, modern, upbeat electronic instrumental with a gentle build, a soft whoosh on each transition and a gentle shimmer when the light elements appear. No vocals and no spoken words.
AVOID
No text, numbers, subtitles, logos or brand names added to the video. No changes to the product's shape, color, buttons, ports or marks. No people, hands, cars or other objects. Nothing covering or touching the product. No cartoon or animated style. No sudden jumps, flickering or morphing of the product. No spoken dialogue.

	6. Claims to Avoid and Rules to Follow
* Never say "in stock", "ready now" or "only a few left" unless it is true at that moment. Say "order today, we buy it for you and deliver it".
* Never present an AI image as proof of an order or as a photo of a real customer. AI images are for ideas and product spotlights. Only real photos prove real orders.
* Use the official product photo for Product Spotlight images and videos, so the picture matches what the customer receives.
* Say "genuine", "original" or "warranty" only if your supplier confirms it in writing, and state the warranty exactly as the supplier gives it.
* Publish only confirmed prices. Fill every [BEI] and [PRICE] with the real price before posting, and re-check it if the supplier price changes.
* Always tell the customer the product, the price and the delivery time in writing before they pay.
* Customer messages, names, photos and payment details: share only with permission, and hide private details.
* Tech facts: only post facts you can explain. The facts in this calendar are general and simplified, such as the 60 to 70 percent power bank figure, so keep the words "karibu" (about) and "kwa kawaida" (usually).
* Giveaway (Day 27): free to enter with no purchase needed, a clear closing time, a line saying the platform is not involved, the prize delivered as promised, and a check of local promotion rules.
* Do not use designer or competitor brand names in your own claims. The only brand you name is oraimo, and only for products you can really source from the oraimo supplier.
Details to confirm before you start
* Delivery area (Dar es Salaam only, or across Tanzania) and the normal delivery time.

prompts.label: Google Flow 10s Video Prompt: Vanilla 28 Car Freshener, Floating
prompts.text:
FORMAT AND STYLE
A 10 second vertical video, 9:16 aspect ratio, 24 frames per second. A photorealistic, high-end studio commercial, as if filmed on a cinema camera with a macro lens and professional studio lighting. It has four scenes of about 2.5 seconds each, joined by smooth, soft transitions. The background is a pure, clean, seamless white studio backdrop, with no horizon line, no floor line and no shadows on the background. There are no people, no hands, no cars, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos and no watermarks anywhere in the video.
THE PRODUCT (use the attached reference image as the exact product)
The hero product is the hanging car air freshener shown in the attached image: a small glass bottle with a raw, natural wooden cap and a thin cord. Reproduce it exactly as it appears in the image: the same bottle shape and proportions, the same glass, the same liquid color, the same wooden cap with its natural grain, the same cord, and the same label and printing. Do not redesign, enlarge, recolor or invent anything on it, and do not add any text to it. The bottle floats weightlessly in mid-air, perfectly upright, with the wooden cap at the top and the label facing the camera. The cord floats just above the cap in one soft, gentle curve and drifts only slightly. CORD RULE: copy the cord exactly from the attached photo: the same single thin strand, the same thickness, the same color and the same way it is tied. The cord must stay one single strand in every scene. It must never split, branch, fork, tangle, double up, or grow extra strands, loops, knots or loose ends. posts.fullText:
1. Profile Setup (Do This First)
1.1 Names and Bios
Character limits were checked in October 2026: the Instagram bio allows 150 characters, the TikTok bio allows 80 characters, the TikTok display name allows 30 characters, and the Instagram name field allows 64 characters. Emojis count as characters, so every option below was counted with the emojis included.
Field
	Text to use
	Characters used
	Instagram name
	NolMart Scents | Perfume & Car Air Fresheners
	45 of 64
	Instagram bio (recommended)
	Hand-blended in Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿
🧴 60% oil perfumes that last
🚗 Car air fresheners that keep their scent
👇 DM to order
	117 of 150
	TikTok name
	NolMart Scents | Dar es Salaam
	30 of 30
	TikTok bio (recommended)
	60% oil perfumes 🧴 + car air fresheners 🚗 Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿 Order below 👇
	71 of 80
	

Alternative bios
Option
	Text
	Characters used
	Instagram alternative A
	Perfumes with 60% oil that last 🧴 Car air fresheners that keep one scent 🚗
📍Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿 | Order via DM or WhatsApp 👇
	120 of 150
	Instagram alternative B
	60% oil perfumes that last 🧴
Car air fresheners that keep their scent 🚗
📍Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿 | DM to order 👇
	104 of 150
	TikTok alternative A
	Perfumes that last 🧴 Car air fresheners 🚗 Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿 DM to order 👇
	71 of 80
	TikTok alternative B
	60% oil perfumes 🧴 Car air fresheners 🚗 Dar es Salaam 🇹🇿
	55 of 80
	

Why this bio wins against competitors
* It says what you sell in the first three seconds: perfumes and car air fresheners, with the emojis doing the explaining.
* It gives one hard, checkable difference. "60% oil" is a concrete number a visitor can compare. Many popular Eau de Parfum bottles sit around 15 to 20 percent oil, so your number is easy to remember and easy to repeat.
* It names the place and the maker. "Hand-blended in Dar es Salaam" builds trust in a market where people fear online scams.
* It ends with one next step (DM to order), never two.
If you deliver outside Dar es Salaam, add a line such as "Delivery across Tanzania" once you are sure it is true.
1.2 Other Setup Items (Do All of These Before the First Post)
* Profile photo: the NolMart Scents logo in gold on the charcoal-navy background, the same on both apps, so people recognise you instantly.
* Link: one link only, to your WhatsApp order chat or your order page. Check what your TikTok account type allows, because some link features depend on account type or follower count.
* Instagram category: set the account to a professional account with a shopping or retail category so the contact details and category show clearly.
* TikTok account type: business accounts can restrict which sounds you can use. If you want trending sounds, check which account type allows them before you choose.
* Instagram highlights (made from Stories): Scents, Car, How to Order, Proof, Questions. Add to them as you create content.
* Pinned posts: on TikTok pin three videos (the brand intro, the 60 percent oil video, the hanging air freshener video). On Instagram pin the intro, the scent lineup carousel and the how-to-order post.
* Cross-promotion from your main @_nolmart account: one Story, one bio line ("Perfumes and car air fresheners now live at NolMart Scents") and one post introducing the new page. This is your fastest source of the first followers.
* ManyChat keywords (your existing comment-trigger system): "PERFUME" sends the perfume catalogue, "CAR" sends the car air freshener details, and "FLEET" sends the wholesale offer.
2. Strategy on One Page
2.1 The Goal for the First 30 Days
Get seen by as many people in Dar es Salaam and across Tanzania as possible, give them a clear reason to follow, and make ordering effortless. At first, measure only four things: profile visits, new followers, saves and shares, and direct messages.
2.2 Five Content Pillars
Pillar
	Share
	What it does
	Scent School
	30 percent
	Teaches something useful about perfume, so people follow you for knowledge.
	The Scent Lineup
	25 percent
	Shows your scents, sizes and moods so people know what to ask for.
	Drive Fresh
	20 percent
	The car air freshener series. This is your least crowded topic locally, so it is your best chance to be remembered.
	Behind the Blend
	15 percent
	Shows how everything is made and measured. This is your answer to online distrust.
	Community and Fun
	10 percent
	Polls, this-or-that and relatable posts that earn comments and shares.
	

2.3 Weekly Rhythm (One Main Post Per Day)
Day
	Pillar
	Format
	Monday
	Scent School
	Video
	Tuesday
	Scent Lineup
	Carousel
	Wednesday
	Drive Fresh
	Video
	Thursday
	Scent School or questions
	Carousel
	Friday
	Community and Fun
	Video
	Saturday
	Behind the Blend
	Carousel
	Sunday
	Soft sell, poll or recap
	Single image
	That gives you 3 videos, 3 carousels and 1 single image per week, which matches what Gemini lets you produce.
2.4 Posting Times and Daily Routine
* Main post: 7:30 PM East Africa Time, when people are relaxed and ready to engage.
* Optional light post at 12:30 PM: reshare the post as a Story or post a poll sticker. Skip it on tired days.
* Launch burst: publish Days 1, 2 and 3 on the same day, a few hours apart, so new visitors see a profile with content instead of an empty page. From Day 4 onward, post one per day.
* Daily engagement (15 minutes): leave 10 genuine comments on local Dar es Salaam business, car, beauty and fragrance accounts. Reply to every comment on your own posts within the hour in the first week.
2.5 More Ways to Get Known With Zero Followers
* Use Dar es Salaam and product words in captions and on-screen text, because both apps work like search engines.
* Make every post worth sharing: a tip to save, a poll to answer, or a friend to tag.
* Run the giveaway in Week 4 (Days 22 to 29) to bring in followers quickly.
* Turn buyers into proof: after each early order, ask permission to share a screenshot or photo of the customer's message.
3. Production Guide for Gemini
3.1 Sizes
* Images, carousels and single graphics: 4:5 portrait, 1080 by 1350 pixels. This is the Instagram size, and it also works on TikTok photo posts.
* Videos: vertical 9:16, 1080 by 1920 pixels, always one 10-second shot.
* These sizes are already written inside every prompt. If Gemini gives you a different size, crop or resize in your phone gallery or Canva, and keep the important elements in the centre.
3.2 Making a Carousel Look Like One Set
1. In a new Gemini chat, paste the prompt for slide 1 (the cover) and regenerate until you love it.
2. In the same chat, attach slide 1, then paste the prompt for slide 2. Repeat for every slide.
3. Check each slide against slide 1. If the background colour, gold shade, bottle shape or text style drifts, regenerate that slide.
4. Start a new chat for every new carousel.
5. AI text can contain spelling errors. If a word is wrong, regenerate once, or remove the word from the prompt and add it yourself in Canva or the Instagram editor.
3.3 Video Rule: One 10-Second Shot Only
Every video in this playbook is a single 10-second shot made from one prompt. Continuing a video from the last frame of a previous clip did not work reliably, so that method has been removed completely. Each video prompt describes the whole story of its 10 seconds, from start to final pose, so the clip can be posted exactly as Gemini creates it.
* Use one prompt, generate once, and regenerate only if the result is wrong.
* Add the text overlays and sound in CapCut or the app editor, because text inside AI video is unreliable.
* If you want a longer video, post two different 10-second videos on two different days instead of joining them.
3.4 Planning Around Your Video Limit (About 2 Videos Every 6 Hours)
* Run one video session each Sunday with two windows. Window 1 (morning): the videos for Monday and Wednesday. Window 2 (about 6 hours later): the Friday video plus one spare attempt for any retry.
* That gives you 4 attempts for 3 videos a week, so one failed generation never ruins the week.
* Carousels and single images do not use the video limit, so generate those during the week.
3.5 Fixing Common AI Problems
Problem
	What to do
	Misspelled text
	Regenerate once. If it is still wrong, delete that word from the prompt and add it yourself in Canva or the Instagram editor.
	The bottle changes shape
	Attach the previous slide as a reference and add the sentence: "Keep the bottle exactly the same as in the attached image."
	A person or hand appears
	Add at the start and the end of the prompt: "No people, no faces and no hands."
	Text appears inside a video
	Add: "No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the video," and remove the text in the editor.
	Colours drift
	Regenerate and keep the hex colour codes in the prompt.
	The video ends in a different place than planned
	Rewrite the ENDING line in one sentence describing the exact final pose.
	4. The 30-Day Content Calendar
Day 1 is a Monday. If you start on Monday 12 October 2026, Day 30 is Tuesday 10 November 2026. Hooks are written in Swahili first, with the English meaning in brackets, because Swahili stops the scroll for a Tanzanian audience. Mix in English words naturally.

posts.title: Day 8: Scent School - Monday
posts.hook: "Chupa mbili zinafanana nje. Ndani ni tofauti kabisa." (Two bottles look the same outside. Inside they are completely different.)
posts.message: The more real perfume oil in the bottle, the stronger and longer the scent. A typical Eau de Parfum has roughly 15 to 20 percent oil. Yours has 60 percent.
posts.cta: Comment PERFUME to see the range.
posts.notes: Ready-to-paste Gemini prompts and verbatim captions.

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
Create one 10-second video.
FORMAT: vertical 9:16, 1080 x 1920 pixels, 24 frames per second.
STYLE: flat 2D vector animation with clean geometric shapes and a uniform thin line weight. No photorealism. Use only these colours: deep charcoal-navy background (#101626), gold (#C9A24A) for lines and accents, warm off-white (#F4EFE3) for highlights, and one supporting accent colour, gold (#C9A24A) only, with no extra colour. No people, no faces and no hands. Calm, premium, minimalist luxury perfumery mood. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the video. No sound is needed.
CAMERA: A slow push-in toward the right bottle.
SCENE: Two identical bottles stand side by side, each being a slim rectangular frosted-glass perfume spray bottle with a plain matte black label with a thin gold border and no lettering, a round gold cap, and amber liquid visible through the lower half of the glass. The glass of the left bottle shows only a thin line of gold liquid at the bottom. The glass of the right bottle is filled high with glowing gold liquid, and soft gold light pulses gently from it.
ENDING: The right bottle is centred and glowing, the left bottle is slightly out of focus, and the camera is still.

posts.caption:
Chupa mbili zinafanana nje. Ndani ni tofauti kabisa.


Kadiri mafuta halisi ya perfume yanavyokuwa mengi ndani ya chupa, ndivyo harufu inavyokuwa kali na ya kudumu. Perfume nyingi maarufu za Eau de Parfum zina takriban mafuta 15 hadi 20 asilimia. Zetu zina mafuta 60 asilimia.


The more real perfume oil in a bottle, the stronger and longer the scent. Ours are hand-blended with 60 percent oil.


Andika PERFUME kuona aina zetu.


#NolMartScents #NolMart #PerfumeTanzania #Manukato #OilBasedPerfume

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
Create one 10-second video.
FORMAT: vertical 9:16, 1080 x 1920 pixels, 24 frames per second.
STYLE: flat 2D vector animation with clean geometric shapes and a uniform thin line weight. No photorealism. Use only these colours: deep charcoal-navy background (#101626), gold (#C9A24A) for lines and accents, warm off-white (#F4EFE3) for highlights, and one supporting accent colour, warm cream (#F2E3C2). No people, no faces and no hands. Calm, premium, minimalist luxury perfumery mood. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the video. No sound is needed.
CAMERA: A slow push-in toward the bottle.
SCENE: A flat vector car interior silhouette in dark navy, with a windshield outline, a rear-view mirror outline and a soft gold sunlight beam. a small square clear-glass bottle with a raw light-wood round cap, a thin black cord forming a loop above the cap, pale golden liquid filling most of the bottle, and a plain matte black label with a thin gold border and no lettering hangs from the mirror by its black cord and swings very gently side to side. Soft warm cream scent swirls rise around it at a steady, constant rhythm for the whole clip, never fading and never changing colour.
ENDING: The bottle is almost still and centred, and the camera stops.

prompts.label: PROMPT FOR THE VIDEO
prompts.text:
Create one 10-second video.
FORMAT: vertical 9:16, 1080 x 1920 pixels, 24 frames per second.

CAMERA: A slow push-in toward the bottle.
SCENE: A flat vector car interior in a warm orange-gold heat shimmer, with a windshield outline and a rear-view mirror outline. A simple gold thermometer icon on the dashboard rises quickly during the first 4 seconds. a small square clear-glass bottle with a raw light-wood round cap, a thin black cord forming a loop above the cap, pale golden liquid filling most of the bottle, and a plain matte black label with a thin gold border and no lettering hangs from the mirror by its black cord, with steady warm cream scent swirls rising around it. At about 6 seconds the heat shimmer fades to a calm navy, while the bottle and its scent swirls stay exactly the same.
ENDING: A calm still frame on the bottle, with the camera completely still.
